name: Memories
overview: Scripture teaches that memories play a vital role in the believer's walk by calling us to remember God's mighty works and enduring mercy, as seen in Psalms 77:11 and 136:1. Remembering the Lord's faithfulness provides guidance and hope, with His Word described as a lamp illuminating our path (Psalms 119:105). The Bible also contrasts the blessed memory of the righteous with the fleeting legacy of the wicked (Proverbs 10:7), urging us to recall God's unique sovereignty and promises of peace (Isaiah 46:9; Jeremiah 29:11) as a foundation for trust and thanksgiving.
